messages:
ACME Ops: Hey team — our org console shows $2,400 promotional credits after the org merge, but our API calls for the acme-prod service key return balance: 0 and usage is still being billed. Not sure if this is a UI-only display or a real credit attach issue. Can you look?

maria_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the service key ID and the org id? Also which region (us-east/us-west) the requests hit?

ACME Ops: service_key: sk-prod-9a8b7c, org_id: org-acme-42, region: us-east-1. We noticed this right after we merged two accounts yesterday. Console shows Promos -> $2,400 (Org) but project-level billing shows charges.

kevin_billing: thanks. quick checks: did you recently migrate or rename any projects under the org? I've seen credits stick to an old project id after merges. Can you run the credits API for the org and for the service key and paste results? e.g.
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDBIRD_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/credits?org_id=org-acme-42
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDBIRD_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/credits?service_key=sk-prod-9a8b7c
```

ACME Ops: pasted output below (redacted):
```
# org credits
{"org_id":"org-acme-42","available_cents":240000,"allocated":false}
# service key credits
{"service_key":"sk-prod-9a8b7c","available_cents":0,"source":"none"}
```

maria_support: that matches symptom — org-level credit exists but not allocated to the service key. Two common causes: 1) credits are scoped to a legacy project id that didn't get remapped during the merge, or 2) a billing allocation flag wasn't turned on for newly merged projects. I'm going to open an internal ticket and request a forced allocation/resync. Can you confirm you want org credits auto-applied to all service keys under org-acme-42?

ACME Ops: yes please — default behavior expected is credits apply org-wide unless explicitly scoped. We didn't set any project-scoped promo.

kevin_billing: internal note: hitting billing-admin to run allocate_credits(job) for org-acme-42 -> target: all active service keys. Also checking migration logs for project id collisions. @billing_bot can you run "allocate-job --org org-acme-42 --force"?

billing_bot: running allocate-job for org-acme-42 (dry-run first).

billing_bot: dry-run results: 3 service keys would receive allocations: sk-prod-9a8b7c (0 -> $2,400 prorated), sk-staging-45 (already 0 -> would get $0), sk-legacy-33 (stale project map). Potential conflict: sk-legacy-33 mapped to old project id that no longer exists, requires manual remap.

maria_support: thanks — kevin, can you confirm if we should remap credits from the stale project id to org-level pool or directly to sk-prod-9a8b7c? I think customer expects org-level pool to be applied to active keys.

kevin_billing: remap to org pool then allocate. I'll also patch the allocation service to prefer active keys over stale project mappings. Doing a live run now.

billing_bot: allocate-job live run started. Logs:
```
INFO: found org credits 240000 cents
INFO: allocating 239500 cents -> sk-prod-9a8b7c (prorated to current billing cycle)
WARN: stale mapping found for project-id proj-old-33, flagged for manual review
SUCCESS: allocation complete. remaining_org_pool_cents: 500
```

maria_support: ACME Ops — can you re-run the service key credits query and confirm?

ACME Ops: re-run results: 
```
{"service_key":"sk-prod-9a8b7c","available_cents":239500,"source":"org-promo-2026-05"}
```

ACME Ops: confirmed, the balance now shows. Also saw immediate billing credits offset one of today's charges. Thanks! :relieved:

maria_support: great. I'll leave the internal ticket open to remediate the stale project mapping (proj-old-33) so it doesn't recur and add a fallback in the allocation job.

kevin_billing: added a follow-up: we'll add a periodic resync job that identifies org credits not applied to active keys for 48+ hours after any org-level merge.

ACME Ops: appreciated. One small ask — can you send steps to programmatically check this in future so we can alert on our side?

maria_support: sure — quick health checks you can run daily:
1) GET /v1/billing/credits?org_id=org-acme-42  (verify available_cents > 0)
2) GET /v1/billing/credits?service_key=sk-prod-9a8b7c (verify service key sees allocation)
3) GET /v1/usage?service_key=sk-prod-9a8b7c&range=24h (verify recent charges show zeroed or offset tokens)
4) if mismatch, file support with org_id + service_key + output of above commands.

ACME Ops: will do. thanks for quick turnaround!

maria_support: marking issue as resolved on our side. Please reopen if anything else pops up. :white_check_mark:
